question.text: Which of the following will exhibit aromatic character?

solution.text: Since in azulene (IV) two rings share a double bond, therefore, two electrons of this double bond can be counted towards each. As a result, each ring has  <math><mn>6</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi></math> -electrons and hence azulene is aromatic. Pyrrole (II), the two double bonds + one lone pair of electrons on the N atom).
